effect_description_eng:
[Your Turn] When you would play a card with [Belphemon] in its name, by deleting 1 of your Digimon with [Gizmon] in its name, reduce the play cost by the play cost of the deleted Digimon.
[End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand. Then, by placing this Tamer under 1 of your Digimon with [Belphemon] in its name as its bottom digivolution card, delete 1 of your opponent's level 6 Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
